task.title: See the events of a person
task.shortdesc: List what happened in a person's life, such as birth, marriage and death, in date order, and open any one.

prereq.p: Open a person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Choose in the bar along the bottom.

stepresult.p: Each event has a card with its name, its date and its place. A small number at the right counts the sources for it. Events come in date order.

step.cmd: Choose an event to open it.

stepresult.p: A page shows its type, date and place, and a count of sources. Below them are more details, such as the age at the event.

step.cmd: Choose at the top to go back to the list.

result.p: A marriage opens the page of the family. To add an event, choose under the list. shows how.
